"""Tests for Japanese and wide-character handling in tablefmt."""

import unicodedata
import pytest
from tablefmt import render


def display_width(text: str) -> int:
    """Calculate display width of text, accounting for East Asian characters."""
    width = 0
    for char in text:
        # 'W' (Wide) and 'F' (Fullwidth) are 2 columns
        if unicodedata.east_asian_width(char) in ('W', 'F'):
            width += 2
        else:
            # Everything else is 1 column
            width += 1
    return width


class TestJapaneseBasic:
    """Test basic rendering with Japanese characters."""
    
    def test_japanese_simple(self):
        """Japanese characters should render with correct column alignment."""
        result = render([["レポート", "12"], ["notes", "3"]], ["name", "KB"])
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Check structure
        assert len(lines) == 4  # header, separator, 2 data rows
        
        # All lines should have consistent column positions
        # The separator tells us column widths: count dashes and separators
        sep_line = lines[1]
        # Format is: "-+-" with dashes between separators
        sep_parts = sep_line.split('-+-')
        assert len(sep_parts) == 2  # Two columns
    
    def test_japanese_with_mixed_content(self):
        """Mixed Japanese and ASCII in same column should align correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", "12"], ["notes.txt", "3"]],
            ["name", "KB"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Should have header, separator, 2 data rows
        assert len(lines) == 4
        
        # Find pipe separators (column boundaries)
        for line in lines[2:]:  # Data rows only
            if '|' in line:
                parts = line.split('|')
                assert len(parts) == 2
    
    def test_japanese_header(self):
        """Japanese in headers should work correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["report.pdf", "12"], ["document.txt", "3"]],
            ["名前", "サイズ"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        assert len(lines) == 4
        
        # First line should be header
        assert "名前" in lines[0]
        assert "サイズ" in lines[0]
    
    def test_japanese_all_cells(self):
        """All Japanese cells should render consistently."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", "十二"], ["メモ", "三"]],
            ["名前", "数字"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        assert len(lines) == 4
        
        # Check that separator line is well-formed
        sep = lines[1]
        assert '-+-' in sep or sep.count('-') > 0


class TestJapaneseTruncation:
    """Test truncation with Japanese characters and max_width."""
    
    def test_truncate_japanese_with_max_width(self):
        """Japanese text should truncate respecting max_width display width."""
        # "レポート" is 8 columns (4 chars × 2 each)
        result = render([["レポート", "x"]], max_width=6)
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Should truncate the Japanese text
        # With max_width=6, we can fit 2 Japanese chars (4 columns) + ellipsis (1 column) = 5 columns
        # or 3 chars if we're strict, depending on truncation logic
        first_line = lines[0]
        assert "…" in first_line or "レポ" in first_line
    
    def test_truncate_mixed_content(self):
        """Mixed ASCII and Japanese should truncate correctly."""
        # "レポート_data" - レポート (8 cols) + _ (1 col) + data (4 cols) = 13 cols
        result = render([["レポート_data", "x"]], max_width=10)
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        first_line = lines[0]
        assert "…" in first_line
    
    def test_truncate_respects_character_boundary(self):
        """Truncation should not break in middle of wide characters."""
        # "レポ" (4 columns) should truncate to "レ" (2 columns) with ellipsis
        # if max_width=4 (space for 1 wide char + ellipsis)
        result = render([["レポート", "x"]], max_width=3)
        
        # Just verify it doesn't crash and produces output
        assert len(result) > 0
        assert "…" in result or "レ" in result


class TestJapaneseWrapping:
    """Test wrapping with Japanese characters and max_width."""
    
    def test_wrap_japanese_text(self):
        """Japanese text should wrap at appropriate boundaries."""
        # "レポート" (8 columns)
        result = render([["レポート", "x"]], max_width=6, wrap=True)
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Should have multiple lines for the first cell
        # "レポ" = 4 cols fits in max_width=6
        # "ー" = 2 cols on next line (or last 2 chars wrapped)
        # "ト" = 2 cols on another line
        assert len(lines) >= 2
    
    def test_wrap_mixed_ascii_japanese(self):
        """Mixed text should wrap at word and character boundaries."""
        result = render([["レポート file", "x"]], max_width=8, wrap=True)
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Should wrap the long line
        assert len(lines) >= 2
    
    def test_wrap_ascii_unchanged(self):
        """ASCII text wrapping behavior should remain unchanged."""
        # Test that ASCII text wraps as before
        result = render([["one two three", "x"]], max_width=7, wrap=True)
        
        # From existing test: should produce "one two | x\nthree   |"
        expected = "one two | x\nthree   |"
        assert result == expected


class TestJapaneseAlignment:
    """Test alignment with Japanese characters."""
    
    def test_left_align_japanese(self):
        """Left alignment should work with Japanese text."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート"], ["ab"]],
            align="left"
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Japanese char should be on the left
        # "レポート" = 8 cols, "ab" = 2 cols
        # With left alignment, padding goes on the right
        # So first line should be "レポート" (no padding needed)
        # Second line should be "ab      " (with 6 spaces padding)
        
        # Both lines should have same display length
        # We can't directly compare, but we can check structure
        assert all("レ" in line or "a" in line for line in lines)
    
    def test_right_align_japanese(self):
        """Right alignment should work with Japanese text."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート"], ["ab"]],
            align="right"
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # With right alignment, padding goes on the left
        # Japanese chars should be on the right
        assert any("レ" in line for line in lines)
    
    def test_center_align_japanese(self):
        """Center alignment should work with Japanese text."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート"], ["ab"]],
            align="center"
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Center alignment should pad on both sides
        # With odd extra space, right gets the extra
        assert any("レ" in line for line in lines)


class TestJapaneseColumnWidth:
    """Test that column widths are calculated correctly."""
    
    def test_column_width_respects_display_width(self):
        """Column widths should be based on display width, not character count."""
        result = render(
            [["レ", "long"]],
            ["短", "text"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # First column: "レ"=2 cols, "短"=2 cols, so width=2 display columns
        # Second column: "long"=4 cols, "text"=4 cols, so width=4 display columns
        
        # Find column separator position (should be consistent)
        for line in lines:
            if '|' in line:
                # Pipe position should be consistent
                pipe_pos = line.index('|')
                # Should account for display width
                assert pipe_pos >= 2  # At least room for one wide char
    
    def test_column_width_with_mixed_ascii_japanese(self):
        """Column width should accommodate both ASCII and Japanese."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", "x"], ["short", "y"]],
            ["name", "k"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # First column max width: "レポート" = 8 cols
        # Second column max width: "name" = 4 cols
        
        # Separator line shows this
        sep_line = lines[1]
        # Count dashes before -+-
        first_col_dashes = sep_line.split('-+-')[0]
        assert len(first_col_dashes) >= 8  # At least 8 dashes for 8 columns
    
    def test_narrow_column_with_wide_chars(self):
        """When wide characters are in a narrow column, alignment should still work."""
        result = render(
            [["レ", "レポート"], ["a", "short"]],
            ["x", "y"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # First column: max is "レ" = 2 cols
        # Second column: max is "レポート" = 8 cols
        sep_line = lines[1]
        parts = sep_line.split('-+-')
        
        # Second column should have more dashes
        assert len(parts[1]) >= len(parts[0])


class TestJapaneseEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases with Japanese characters."""
    
    def test_empty_cells_with_japanese_header(self):
        """Empty cells should not affect Japanese header layout."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", None], [None, "12"]],
            ["名前", "サイズ"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        assert len(lines) == 4
    
    def test_single_japanese_char(self):
        """Single Japanese characters should render correctly."""
        result = render([["あ", "い", "う"]], ["a", "b", "c"])
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Each column has 1 char (2 display cols each)
        assert "あ" in lines[2]
        assert "い" in lines[2]
        assert "う" in lines[2]
    
    def test_very_long_japanese_text(self):
        """Very long Japanese text should be handled."""
        long_japanese = "レポート" * 10  # Repeating "レポート"
        result = render([[long_japanese, "x"]])
        
        # Should produce output even with very long text
        assert len(result) > 0
    
    def test_numbers_with_japanese_header(self):
        """Numbers in columns with Japanese headers should auto-align correctly."""
        result = render(
            [[123, 456], [1, 2]],
            ["数字", "数字2"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Numeric columns should be right-aligned
        # Even with Japanese headers
        assert len(lines) == 4
    
    def test_fullwidth_numbers(self):
        """Fullwidth numbers should be handled."""
        # Fullwidth digits: １２３ (each is 2 columns)
        result = render([["１２３", "abc"]])
        
        # Should handle fullwidth chars (which are 2 columns each)
        assert len(result) > 0
    
    def test_combining_characters_with_japanese(self):
        """Text mixing Japanese with combining characters."""
        # This is a complex case - combining diacritics with Japanese
        result = render([["レポート", "text"]])
        
        # Should handle without crashing
        assert len(result) > 0


class TestJapaneseMaxWidth:
    """Test max_width parameter with Japanese characters."""
    
    def test_max_width_in_display_columns(self):
        """max_width should be interpreted as display columns, not characters."""
        # "レポート" = 8 display columns
        # With max_width=6, should truncate
        result = render([["レポート"]], max_width=6)
        
        # Should have output
        assert len(result) > 0
        # Should have ellipsis or be truncated
        assert "…" in result or len(result) < len("レポート")
    
    def test_max_width_with_ascii_unchanged(self):
        """ASCII text with max_width should work as before."""
        result = render([["abcdefgh"]], max_width=5)
        
        # From existing test: should truncate to "abcd…"
        expected = "abcd…"
        assert result == expected
    
    def test_max_width_enforcement_with_japanese_header(self):
        """max_width should apply even with Japanese headers."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024_file.pdf"]],
            ["名前"],
            max_width=10
        )
        
        # Should have header and data
        lines = result.split('\n')
        assert len(lines) >= 2
        
        # Data should be truncated
        assert "…" in lines[-1] or len(lines[-1]) < 30


class TestJapaneseConsistency:
    """Test consistency of output with Japanese characters."""
    
    def test_consistent_column_positions(self):
        """Column separator positions should be consistent across rows."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", "12"], ["notes", "3"], ["議事録", "48"]],
            ["name", "KB"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Find pipe position in each data row
        pipe_positions = []
        for line in lines[2:]:  # Data rows only
            if '|' in line:
                pipe_positions.append(line.index('|'))
        
        # All pipe positions should be the same
        assert len(set(pipe_positions)) == 1, f"Inconsistent pipe positions: {pipe_positions}"
    
    def test_trailing_spaces_removed(self):
        """Trailing spaces should be removed from lines."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", "small"], ["x", "verylongtext"]],
            align=["left", "left"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # No line should end with space
        for line in lines:
            assert line == line.rstrip()
    
    def test_separators_aligned_with_columns(self):
        """Separator dashes should align with column widths."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", "12"]],
            ["name", "KB"]
        )
        lines = result.split('\n')
        
        # Separator should be: dashes-+-dashes
        sep = lines[1]
        parts = sep.split('-+-')
        assert len(parts) == 2
        
        # Each part should be dashes only
        for part in parts:
            assert all(c == '-' for c in part)

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseBasicAlignment:
    """Test that Japanese characters don't misalign columns."""

    def test_japanese_in_first_column(self):
        """Japanese in first column should not shift subsequent columns."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", 12, "2024-11-02"], ["notes.txt", 3, "2024-11-20"]],
            ["name", "KB", "modified"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Check that column separators are at same position on all lines
        # Header should have proper alignment
        assert "name" in lines[0]
        assert "KB" in lines[0]
        assert "modified" in lines[0]
        # Separator line
        assert "-+-" in lines[1]
        # Data lines should have separators at same positions
        separator_positions_header = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        separator_positions_data1 = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[2]) if c == "|"]
        separator_positions_data2 = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[3]) if c == "|"]
        assert separator_positions_header == separator_positions_data1
        assert separator_positions_header == separator_positions_data2

    def test_japanese_in_middle_column(self):
        """Japanese in middle column should not shift later columns."""
        result = render(
            [["a.txt", "議事録", 100], ["b.txt", "notes", 200]],
            ["name", "title", "size"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All data lines should have separators at same positions
        separator_positions = {}
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if line:  # skip empty lines
                positions = [j for j, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                if positions:  # lines with separators
                    if i == 0 or i == 2:  # header or data line without dashes
                        if "positions" not in separator_positions:
                            separator_positions["positions"] = positions
                        else:
                            assert positions == separator_positions["positions"], f"Line {i} has misaligned separators"

    def test_japanese_only_rows(self):
        """Table with only Japanese text should line up properly."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", 10], ["議事録", 20]],
            ["名前", "サイズ"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify all rows have separators at same position
        assert len(lines) >= 3  # header, separator, at least 1 data row
        header_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        for line in lines[2:]:  # skip header and separator
            if line:
                data_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                assert header_seps == data_seps, f"Misaligned: {lines[0]}\n{line}"

    def test_mixed_ascii_and_japanese_in_cell(self):
        """Mixed ASCII and Japanese in same cell should be measured correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["report_レポート.txt", 50], ["notes.txt", 30]],
            ["filename", "size"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify alignment
        header_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        for line in lines[2:]:
            if line:
                data_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                assert header_seps == data_seps


class TestJapaneseWidthCalculation:
    """Test that display width is calculated correctly for Japanese text."""

    def test_japanese_char_width_is_two(self):
        """A single Japanese character should take 2 display columns."""
        # "あ" is one character but 2 columns wide
        result = render([["a", "b"], ["あ", "c"]])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Both rows should have separators at the same column
        pos1 = lines[0].find("|")
        pos2 = lines[1].find("|")
        assert pos1 == pos2, "Single Japanese char should align with ASCII char"

    def test_multiple_japanese_chars_width(self):
        """Multiple Japanese characters should be measured at 2 columns each."""
        result = render([["短い", "data"], ["longer_", "more"]])
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify separators align
        positions_1 = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        positions_2 = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[1]) if c == "|"]
        assert positions_1 == positions_2


class TestJapaneseTruncation:
    """Test truncation with max_width respects display width."""

    def test_truncate_japanese_text_respects_display_width(self):
        """max_width should truncate based on display columns, not character count."""
        # "レポート" is 4 characters but 8 display columns
        # With max_width=5, should truncate to show about 2 chars (4 columns) + ellipsis
        result = render([["レポート長い", "x"]], max_width=5)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should have truncation marker and proper alignment
        assert "…" in lines[0]
        # The truncated text should not exceed display width of 5
        parts = lines[0].split(" | ")
        truncated_cell = parts[0]
        # Verify it ends with ellipsis
        assert truncated_cell.rstrip().endswith("…")

    def test_truncate_mixed_content_respects_display_width(self):
        """Truncation with mixed ASCII and Japanese should respect display width."""
        result = render([["abcレポート", "x"]], max_width=6)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        assert "…" in lines[0]

    def test_truncate_maintains_alignment_with_other_rows(self):
        """Truncated rows should still align with non-truncated rows."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート長い名前", 10], ["short.txt", 20]],
            ["name", "size"],
            max_width=8,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All content rows should have separators at same positions
        header_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        for i, line in enumerate(lines[2:]):  # skip header and separator
            if line:
                data_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                assert header_seps == data_seps, f"Row {i} misaligned after truncation"


class TestJapaneseWrapping:
    """Test wrapping with max_width respects display width."""

    def test_wrap_japanese_text_respects_display_width(self):
        """wrap should break lines based on display columns, not character count."""
        result = render([["レポート長いテキスト", "x"]], max_width=6, wrap=True)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should have multiple lines
        assert len(lines) > 1
        # First cell of each line should respect max_width in display columns
        for line in lines:
            if line:
                parts = line.split(" | ")
                first_cell = parts[0].rstrip()
                # Hard to verify exact width, but verify structure is reasonable
                assert len(first_cell) >= 1

    def test_wrap_mixed_content_respects_display_width(self):
        """Wrapping with mixed ASCII and Japanese should respect display width."""
        result = render([["abc レポート def", "x"]], max_width=8, wrap=True)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should have multiple lines for wrapped content
        assert len(lines) >= 2

    def test_wrap_maintains_column_alignment(self):
        """Wrapped rows should maintain column alignment."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート日本語テキスト", 10], ["short", 20]],
            ["name", "size"],
            max_width=6,
            wrap=True,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify separators align (excluding separator line with dashes)
        content_lines = [l for l in lines if l and "-+-" not in l]
        if len(content_lines) > 1:
            first_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(content_lines[0]) if c == "|"]
            for line in content_lines[1:]:
                if "|" in line:
                    seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                    assert first_seps == seps, f"Wrapped content misaligned: {lines}"


class TestJapaneseAlignment:
    """Test alignment (left, right, center) with Japanese text."""

    def test_right_align_japanese(self):
        """Right-aligned Japanese columns should pad on the left."""
        result = render([["レポート", 100], ["a", 1]], ["name", "KB"])

        )

        for line in lines[2:]:
            if line:
                data_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                assert header_seps == data_seps

    def test_center_align_japanese(self):
        """Center-aligned Japanese columns should pad evenly."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート"], ["ab"]],
            align="center",
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify both rows exist
        assert len(lines) >= 2


class TestJapaneseEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases with Japanese text."""

    def test_empty_cell_with_japanese_neighbors(self):
        """Empty cells should not affect Japanese alignment."""
        result = render(
            [[None, "レポート"], ["text", None]],
            ["col1", "col2"],

        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify alignment
        pos1 = lines[0].find("|")
        pos2 = lines[1].find("|")
        assert pos1 == pos2

    def test_all_japanese_text(self):
        """Table with all Japanese text should align properly."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", "文書"], ["短い", "長い名前"]],
            ["名前", "分類"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify separators align across all lines
        header_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        for line in lines[2:]:
            if line:
                data_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                assert header_seps == data_seps

    def test_very_long_japanese_text_with_max_width(self):
        """Very long Japanese text with max_width should truncate correctly."""
        long_japanese = "レポート" * 10  # 40 characters, 80 display columns
        result = render([[long_japanese, "x"]], max_width=10)
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should have ellipsis
        assert "…" in lines[0]
        parts = lines[0].split(" | ")
        # First cell should not exceed reasonable width
        assert len(parts[0].rstrip()) <= 15  # Some reasonable upper bound

    def test_japanese_in_different_rows(self):
        """Japanese in different rows should not cause cascading misalignment."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート", "a"], ["b", "議事録"], ["c", "d"]],
            ["col1", "col2"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All content rows should have separators at same position
        header_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
        for line in lines[2:]:
            if line:
                data_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(line) if c == "|"]
                assert header_seps == data_seps, f"Misaligned row: {line}"

    def test_japanese_with_numbers_auto_alignment(self):
        """Japanese in first column, numbers in second should auto-align correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート_2024.pdf", 12], ["notes.txt", 3]],
            ["name", "KB"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify alignment
        header_seps = [i for i, c in enumerate(lines[0]) if c == "|"]
